verdict.rationale: Godot's own README claims one-click export to Web-based platforms. Community reports confirm web export works, notably in Godot 3.5.2, but note that C# projects cannot be exported to the web. Nothing in the pack covers payload size, the WebGL renderer specifically, or any WebGPU plans. Missing for 10: evidence of reasonable web payload size, documented WebGL rendering backend details, any WebGPU roadmap or support, and web export for C# projects.
